The four answers are bra, camp, day and wheels.Quick tips for Connections#1: Say the clue words out loud, pausing before and after each. That helps you hear the words in the context of a phrase. The Connections editors love to group words together that are used in similar phrasing, like ____ Up.#2: Don't go for the obvious grouping. These editors are smart. Once, they offered SPONGE, BOB, SQUARE and PANTS in the same puzzle. None of those words were in the same category. If you like, hit the "shuffle" button to give yourself a different perspective on the words.#3: Break down any compound words and look for similarities. "Rushmore" was once in a puzzle where the connection was that each word started with the name of a rock band.
